title: French Defense: Rubinstein Variation
line: Black gives up the center pawn for easy development and trades White's strong knight.

steps.text: In the French, White's knight came out to guard the pawn on e4.
Take the pawn on e4. Black gives up the center for easy development.

also.g8f6: That is the Classical Variation, another main line. This lesson goes on with the Rubinstein.
also.f8b4: That is the Winawer Variation, another main line. This lesson goes on with the Rubinstein.

steps.text: Bring the knight to d7. It gets ready to back up the other knight.
Bring the other knight out. It challenges White's knight in the center.
Push the pawn on c7 two squares to hit the pawn on d4.

steps.after: Black has no weak pawns, the bishop on c5 is active, and the king is ready to castle.

summary: In the Rubinstein, Black takes in the center, trades White's best knight and develops easily.
